statement: [§1 — ch8 packet decision, dissent, and packet constraints (CH-N1)] Your verdict (c) is accepted: the copy commission STANDS and the run proceeds without waiting on the ch8 packet. I do not object. Rationale for the record: (1) at -19.93 dBFS the stack is legible and nothing breaks — the failure is dramatic, not functional; (2) the hold EXPOSED a defect the same-tick exit was hiding, it did not create one — shipping the copy first makes the score defect visible, auditable, and owner-auditionable (your four WAVs); (3) ch7/ch8 are unshipped surface behind ch4-arrival, so there is runway for the packet before any player hears the mismatch. The mismatch goes to the dissent register verbatim: 'CONTACT LOGGED. lands mid-anthem (-19.93 dBFS vs -23.83 composed-near-silence yardstick) until the separately-routed ch8-launch score packet lands; the dramatic ask of the commission is unmet by construction in the shipped ramp.' I endorse your named bounded packet scope as written — gameplay-derived variants from committed facts, no timeline cues, mirroring ch7's grammar — and I add three chapter-side constraints that must ride into the packet's commission if the owner approves it: (a) the exit-decay variant keys on the SAME durable deep_space fact the R2 hold observes, never on a stack cadence offset — the score must not know the copy's clock; (b) no score event may stamp CONTACT LOGGED. — your own silence law, now also mine: silence is the cue; (c) the L6 window's emptiness is composed output and no one may fill it, packet or no packet. Your §3 relations table freezes as-is for THIS contract with the (packet) column recorded as intent-only. [§2 — ch7 taste notes answered and closed (CH-N2)] Your two ch7 taste notes, answered so they are on the record and closed rather than rediscovered. M2 (bench whisper vs. line weight): the line carries alone BY DESIGN — 'everything after this is allowed to be heavy' is permission granted to the future, not description of the present; the score granting only a whisper of sub is the correct reading, because the weight that arrives is the player's own labor across the next four stages, and your accretion arc IS that weight arriving. I confirm: no action, and I would object to a bench swell if one were proposed. M6 (route swell as commitment vs. watchedness): I endorse your reading and your ruling. The swell is the act — 'i put it in anyway.' is a commitment line whose text carries the surveillance; the score carrying the choice while the words carry the cost is the two voices doing different jobs at the same moment, which is the whole design. The watched reading getting its answer 8 s later in calibration's unresolved semitone is the correct delay. No packet is wanted at M6; do not sharpen it on my account. Also for the record: your §4 square-wave observation for the eventual ch8 packet — the square as the system's one taught timbre — is narratively right and I support it entering the packet's audition cycle, bounded by constraint (b) above: it may exist as ambient foreign body while the rows file; it must never behave as a stinger acknowledging any row. [§3 — cadence heads-up, score-relevant deltas only (CH-N6)] Heads-up so reconciliation holds no surprises: Cinematography's lane requires a frozen ch7 exit mini-cadence inside the D9 window you signed (M7 audit +0.0, M7 caption +0.6, exit caption +3.0, advance +5.0 — my counter of their +2.6 by caption character math), and I have revised the ch8 window's internal offsets to grant their L6-tail reservation without exceeding R2's 17.0 s bound (stack +2.0/+4.0/+6.0, CONTACT LOGGED. +8.5, designation +11.5, L6 +14.0, advance +17.0). Score-relevant deltas only: (1) your ch7 ruling already covers the exit cadence — calibration mood holds through the window and the seam retune is unchanged; nothing new lands on your lane; (2) in ch8 the anchor-to-advance interval is unchanged at 17.0 s, so your §2 loudness finding, the 0.5-intensity window analysis, and the crossing-seam timing all remain valid as measured — CONTACT LOGGED. moves from +10.0 to +8.5 within the same held state, which slightly worsens nothing (identical intensity plateau) and your packet's exit-decay intent is unaffected per constraint (a). If either shift changes any ruling of yours, flag it in reconciliation; otherwise no response needed beyond acknowledgement.
requestedAction: Carry the shipped-relations column of your §3 into the contract; confirm packet-side constraints (a)-(c) in reconciliation so the packet commission inherits them; record the dissent line verbatim in dissent-register.md; mark both taste notes acknowledged-and-closed; carry the square-wave option into the packet scope as creative option, not obligation, with constraint (b) attached; acknowledge that the revised ch7 exit cadence and ch8 internal offsets leave your §1/§2 rulings and D9 signature standing, or flag if not.

The three chapter-side packet constraints are CONFIRMED and inherited into the packet commission: (a) the exit-decay variant keys on the durable deep_space fact only — satisfied by construction in my scope (gameplay-derived variants, no timeline cues; the decay's internal time constant is a musical envelope from the fact edge, precedent: the shipped ch7-board pressure-seal envelope, and it never references any copy offset — the score does not know the copy's clock); (b) no score event stamps CONTACT LOGGED. — already my own silence law, now bilateral; (c) L6's emptiness is composed output no one may fill — frozen, see also SC-N6/CN-N6. The square-wave option is carried into the packet scope exactly as bounded: creative option, not obligation; audition-cycle only; ambient foreign body while the rows file; never a stinger acknowledging any row — CH-N1(b) attached. SC-N1 and SC-N2 close with this. [SC-R3 → CH-N6, disposition accept] Acknowledged, and the load-bearing claim is VERIFIED against my measured curve, not just accepted: the intensity plateau inside the R2 window is flat by mechanism — the atmosphere-exit anchor applies setScoreIntensity(0.5) once at window start (signedSceneAvRuntime.ts:375-379), the ch8-launch mood is constant for the beat, and nothing time-varies intensity until the advance calls setScoreMood (scoreEngine.ts:1484) — so CONTACT LOGGED. at +8.5 s sits in the state my evidence/score-ch8-window_ch8-hold-contact-logged.wav render measured (-19.93 dBFS), identical to +10.0 s. With the advance unchanged at +17.0 s, the 0.4375→0.42→0.35 seam timing, the crossing-seam render, and the §2 loudness finding all stand unmodified; variant D's ~1.75 s publish has no score coupling. The revised ch8 internal offsets (+2.0/+4.0/+6.0/+8.5/+11.5/+14.0/advance +17.0) change no score ruling — SC-N5's event-anchored-seam statement holds at these final values. The revised ch7 exit cadence (+0.0/+0.6/+3.0/advance +5.0, Chapter's +3.0 counter of Cinematography's +2.6) likewise changes nothing on my lane: the calibration mood holds through the whole window regardless of where captions fire inside it, and the calibration→boarding seam is same-family same-baseline (0.56→0.56) — SC-N4's zero-score-cost ruling and my D9 signature at 5.0 s hold at the final table. Both cadence tables are confirmed from the score side at their final values. [SC-R6 — CLOSURE RECORD for my own outgoing objection SC-N3 (ch8 near-silence not provided by shipped score)] CLOSABLE — the objection no longer blocks contract freeze. CH-N1 satisfies terms 1-3 explicitly (shipped-relations freeze with packet column intent-only; unmet-by-shipped recorded with the packet endorsed at my bounded scope; the dissent-register line provided verbatim, which I co-sign) and term 4 in substance; the sole residual is mechanical, carried as a signoff condition rather than an open objection: the contract text must include the explicit no-near-silence-claim sentence and dissent-register.md must contain the CH-N1 line verbatim at freeze. SC-N3 moves to resolved upon those two texts landing in the frozen contract revision; the underlying musical defect remains OPEN BY DESIGN in the dissent register until the separately-routed packet lands or the owner declines it — that openness is the recorded mechanism, not a blocker.

statement: [§1 — revised ch8 cadence table; supersedes story-intent.md §6 defaults (CH-N3)] L6 tail accepted — here are the revised offsets I will carry into the contract; these constants are mine and this table supersedes story-intent.md §6. I take your option 1 (L6 at +14.0, advance stays +17.0, inside R2's recorded ~15-17 s bound) and solve the problem it would otherwise create upstream: moving L6 alone to +14.0 would cut the designation caption's slot to 1.5 s, below its ~1.8 s typewriter reveal (54 chars x 34 ms) — a mid-typewriter overwrite of the single most canon-sensitive line in the run. So the stack compresses upstream instead; audit rows need only ~0.5-1.2 s at 22 ms/char, so the 'printer' loses nothing: L4 caption +0.0 | stack 1 +2.0 | stack 2 +4.0 | stack 3 +6.0 | CONTACT LOGGED. +8.5 | designation caption +11.5 | L6 +14.0 | advance +17.0. Slot math: stack rows 2.0/2.0/2.5 s (reveals 1.2/0.8/0.5 s); CONTACT LOGGED. holds the audit band 3.0 s of near-empty pill before its natural fade — the punch slot actually GROWS from 2.5 to 3.0 s; designation gets 2.5 s (1.8 reveal + 0.7 read); L6 gets 3.0 s tail (1.4 reveal + 1.6 held) meeting your >=3 s ask. Relationships unchanged: audit stamps, voice answers, silence closes. Variant D still publishes at ~1.75 s, before stack 1. [§2 — ch7 exit mini-cadence: accepted in structure, one interval countered (CH-N4)] Your §2.1 ch7 exit mini-cadence: ACCEPTED in structure — it fixes the same-tick M7/exit collision you correctly caught (both latches test the same receipt in the same tickReconstruction pass; the intent listed the moments but froze no offsets between them — your catch, my miss), and it locks D9 at 5.0 s, which now has all three lanes aligned (Score signed at zero musical cost; you signed conditional on this cadence; I proposed it). One interval counter, by the same character math you tuned with: the M7 caption is 63 chars — at 34 ms/char its reveal alone is ~2.1 s, so your +0.6 -> +2.6 slot (2.0 s) overwrites it mid-typewriter, the exact defect class this run exists to kill. Counter-table, advance value unchanged: M7 audit +0.0 | M7 caption +0.6 | exit caption +3.0 | advance +5.0. Slots become: M7 caption 2.4 s (2.1 reveal + 0.3 read — tight but complete); exit caption 2.0 s held in-beat (1.3 reveal + 0.7 read) plus ~0.2 s into ch7-board before the accepted-drift overwrite. Also ACCEPTED as intended-accept, on the record: the M7 AUDIT NETWORK pill persisting ~1.5 s into ch7-board's black boarding frame — the index following the worker into the cockpit is tonally correct and reviewers should score it as authored, not leaked. And acknowledged with thanks: your §4 finding that D9 incidentally gives cin.reconstruct.09 its first real screen life (~0.8 s -> ~5 s) — that is now part of D9's recorded justification; your movie-path degenerate-close-up caveat and capture-spec items 2/3 are adopted as the evidence route, and if the movie-path reveal frame is degenerate it routes as your separate shot-defect packet, not into this run. [§3 — liftoff tree: routing decision and dissent record (CH-N5)] Liftoff tree ruling: I choose your route (ii) — request the separately-routed camera packet on cin.launch.02-world-below, and the L3 line FREEZES AS WRITTEN in this contract. How the contract records the unsupported-on-screen status: a dissent-register entry, verbatim: 'L3's image support is OPEN — the hero tree is not findable in any captured liftoff frame (nose-up sky-only framing, evidence-hires/ch8-launch/002_005s and siblings); the line ships as authored interior truth pending the routed cin.launch.02 camera packet; if the owner declines the packet, L3 returns to me as a routed repair with contractChangeRequired: true (line meaning changes), not as a silent reword.' Note the honest fallback reading meanwhile: 'i keep finding it' is the voice claiming repeated voluntary glances the shipped frame cannot witness — defensible as interiority, but I agree it is weaker than seeing the tree, which is why the packet is my ask. Chapter-side constraints on the packet scope you drafted: (a) attitude authoring over any forced glance — no look seizure, agency stays player per visual law and the intent's held-drift framing; if only a control-taking glance can deliver the tree, bring that back to the triad rather than assume it; (b) no marker, glint, or HUD affordance on the tree — finding it is voluntary and unrewarded or the line lies in a new way; (c) movie autopilot inherits the same attitude so the movie path stops contradicting the line, per your own packet text; (d) hand-back unchanged at anc.launch.atmosphere-exit so the L4-L6 cadence window is untouched.
